verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents AI Auto Labels that classify mail on arrival and separate marketing, cold pitches and social updates. It also offers Auto Archive for low-priority mail and split-inbox tabs, plus custom Auto Labels defined by plain-language prompts, so labeling, categorizing and steering are all covered. Custom prompt labels are limited to Business and Enterprise plans, and nothing documents auditing why a message was labeled or archived. Missing for 10: any audit or explanation trail for triage decisions, custom-label steering on all plans, and hands-on corroboration of AI labeling accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: With Auto Labels, Superhuman Mail automatically classifies incoming messages — so you can focus on what matters most.

you can make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts, and then split your inbox into tabs using these custom Auto Labels.
